title: Empty Segment conversion dereferences an unowned first frame
mechanism: Segment::slice accepts start == end and returns a zero-length segment holding no reference; both TryFrom<Segment<dyn AnyFrameMeta>> conversions unconditionally do Frame::from_raw(range.start) and a dyn_meta() virtual call on a frame the segment does not own.
contract: ostd frame API: Segment<M> -> Segment<dyn AnyFrameMeta> -> Segment<M> is the identity, and a segment never reads metadata of frames it does not own.
observed: An empty end-boundary slice makes the conversion answer from a neighboring frame's metadata (identity broken, typed frames accepted as USegment); at 4c1fdd1e4 an uninitialized slot killed the kernel.

repro.how_to_run: Install the ktest module as ostd/src/mm/frame/cr11_repro.rs, build a worktree-local OSDK with OSDK_LOCAL_DEV=1, and run each of the four cr11_repro tests in its own `cargo osdk test` boot from ostd/; FAILED tests are the positive result.
repro.runtime_status: REPRODUCED at 604948581 (wrong-answer cases; kernel death only at 4c1fdd1e4)

caveats: Kernel-internal API, not userspace-reachable. The kernel-death outcome is environment-dependent and was not reproduced at 604948581 (kernel survived, wrong answer only); never describe it as a panic. Original external run ID not recorded.
